name: newsletter-section
purpose: The closing band whose ask is a newsletter sign-up: the overline and a large headline on the lead side, a subscribe form labelled by the ask on the other, over a strip lit by the pixelated primary wave, then the hatched closing frame. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'newsletter-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `registration-frame`, `eyebrow`, `field`, `input`, `button` and `texture`. The block never sends: it validates the address locally (an empty field and a malformed address each show their message under the field) and on a valid submit emits `submit` with the event and `{ email }`; the site posts the address and reports the outcome back through `loading`, `submitted` and `failed`, which the band renders with the messages from `form`.
useWhen: Use NewsletterSection when the closing ask is an email field.
To close the Blog or the Resource Hub on a newsletter subscription.
avoidWhen: For a close on one or two link actions or a command → use `closing-call-to-action`.
For a close that lists deployable templates → use `template-gallery` with `closing`.
For a lead form with several fields → use `hero-form-section`.
related: `closing-call-to-action` — the closing band whose ask is a link action.
`alert` — renders the success and failure messages.
bestPractices: Set `loading` while the address is sent, then `submitted` or `failed` with the outcome.
Keep `description` to one sentence; it is set as the large headline.
Write `form.invalidMessage` with an example address so the fix is obvious.

Place it last on the page, right above `site-footer`, after a hatched `section-gap`. It draws the hatched closing frame itself, so nothing follows it inside the page column: no trailing `SectionGap` and no closing `RegistrationFrame` + `Texture` (the `shell/site` close is for a page that ends on any other band). `webkit/no-gap-after-closing-section` flags the doubled close.

props.name: form
props.doc: Copy of the subscribe form: `{ placeholder, submitLabel, successMessage, errorMessage, requiredMessage, invalidMessage }`.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: Eyebrow on the lead side, closed by the blinking cursor.

props.name: title
props.doc: The ask, rendered as the label of the email field; it also names the band. Empty, the field keeps a visually hidden built-in label.

props.name: description
props.doc: The pitch, rendered as the band's large `h2` on the lead side.

props.name: loading
props.doc: The site is sending the address: the field is disabled, the button shows its loading state and a submit is ignored.

props.name: submitted
props.doc: The site sent the address: the form gives way to `form.successMessage`.

props.name: failed
props.doc: The site could not send the address: `form.errorMessage` shows under the form.

props.name: hatch
props.doc: Draws the hatched closing frame under the band; turn it off when another closing band stacks directly below and draws the shared frame.

events.name: submit
events.notes: Fired on a valid submit, not while `loading`; `values` is `{ email }` with the trimmed address. The block never sends it.
